MathJax-NewCM 4.1.3 in WinOne

This distribution uses MathJax's NewCM SVG glyph data. This is NOT a blanket
Apache-2.0 relicensing of the underlying New Computer Modern font.

JavaScript package: @mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font 4.1.3
Publisher's declaration: npm-chat-mathjax-newcm-4.1.3-package.json.txt
MathJax project license (same release): npm-chat-mathjax-newcm-4.1.3-Apache.txt
https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax/blob/0bfa580685ca72e4a3a37657ccd754a65c1a42c6/LICENSE

Original embedded font copyright and GUST declaration:
npm-chat-mathjax-newcm-4.1.3-COPYRIGHT.txt
Underlying New Computer Modern: (C) 2019-2021 Antonis Tsolomitis.
MathJax's modified subsets also identify Copyright (c) 2024 MathJax, Inc.
GUST Font License 1.0 incorporates LPPL 1.3c or later; both full texts accompany
this notice. The metadata extraction and file hashes are in
chat-math-font-evidence.json, produced by build/record-math-font-notices.py.

Source availability and changes:
WinOne does not edit the package files or glyph outlines. It bundles the SVG
modules used by modules/chat-pi/math/convert.mjs into shared/chat/math.js and
preloads their mathematical/Latin ranges for offline rendering. Other scripts
remain native UI text. No WOFF2 files are used as installed system fonts.
The unmodified complete package, including its font definitions, CJS/MJS SVG
source and WOFF2 metadata, is supplied at:
../sources/mathjax-newcm-font-4.1.3.tgz (relative to this notices directory).
Its npm source, integrity and SHA-256 are recorded in chat-math-notices.json:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font/-/mathjax-newcm-font-4.1.3.tgz
The underlying full New Computer Modern distribution is obtainable from:
https://ctan.org/pkg/newcomputermodern
https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/newcomputermodern.zip

The npm package's declared mathjax/MathJax-fonts repository returned 404 during
intake. The public registry archive, embedded font notices and original license
publishers above are the evidence used here; no license file was fabricated to
fill that missing repository. WinOne's integration is maintained by WinOne,
not by the upstream font authors. No upstream support for this integration is
implied. The source package remains identified by its original MathJax names;
WinOne's bundled renderer is named math.js, not an upstream replacement font.
